title: Fleet Steward: interactive scaling controls, throughput timelines, and immutable change chronicle
creator: Aisha Kapoor
description: Design and deliver a single Console surface called 'Fleet Steward' that combines manual and policy-driven scaling controls, a heatmap-style throughput timeline, and an immutable change chronicle for audit and rollback. Goals: 1) let operators safely apply immediate scale changes and schedule policy edits; 2) visualize real historical throughput vs. capacity to diagnose under/overprovisioning; 3) provide an append-only, queryable change chronicle (who/what/why) that ties to rollout IDs and GitHub PRs. Success metrics: a) reduce mean time-to-safe-scale by 40% for on-call teams; b) surface root cause of autoscale incidents in <20 minutes for 80% of cases; c) 90-day audit retention for changes with stable query performance. Constraints: must integrate with existing fleet APIs, respect RBAC and dedicated SLA tiers, and not add significant telemetry costs. Rollout: staged Canary -> Beta -> GA tied to console-2025.03 release.
acceptance_criteria: Console has a Fleet Steward panel per fleet with manual scale up/down and scheduled adjustments
Throughput timeline displays per-minute QPS, queue length, and provisioned capacity overlay for last 30/90/365 days
Change chronicle entries are immutable and include actor, diff, rationale, linked PR/Runbook, and rollout-id
Operators can filter timeline by model, region, and deployment variant
Changes support safe rollback that triggers a canary verification run and emits tracing events
Telemetry emitted for every manual change and autoscale policy update (sized to avoid billing spikes)
notes_and_tradeoffs: Considered full OLAP-backed analytics for timelines but deferred to time-series index to reduce infra scope for 2025.03
Decision: surface simplified policy editor (preset+advanced JSON) to balance speed vs. expressivity for first iteration
Tradeoff: immutable chronicle stored in append-only S3+index vs. DB-backed ledger. Chosen S3 ledger for cheaper long-term retention; will build search index in ES for queries
Privacy: ensure change messages redact customer-specific identifiers unless operator has elevated access
Performance: timeline sampling at 1m resolution by default with optional raw-token-level traces behind feature flag
